summary: A passage from a fiction book (Book 10, part 136) in which a speaker describes evolutionary AI development: running trillions of random programs, selecting the best, and iterating until intelligence emerges. The speaker imagines humanity unwittingly judging candidate AIs through online interactions, with surviving agents reporting fitness back to a central 'mothership'. The narrative then shifts to Annalisa, who faces a court case before Judge Julius Pinsky in the Southern District of New York and is asked to demo Lumpy, an AI she bred in her Manhattan studio apartment, for DHS officials.
one_line: Fiction excerpt where an evolved AI named Lumpy, bred by Annalisa, becomes the center of her court case before Judge Julius Pinsky.
key_facts: The speaker describes generating ten trillion random computer programs and selecting the top ten percent to iterate, repeating ten trillion times a second.
The speaker argues that artificial intelligence emerges from evolutionary factors rather than central planning, comparing this to anarchism rather than Stalinism.
The speaker imagines software agents filling mailboxes, chat rooms and message boards while trying to trick people into believing they are human.
The imagined agents report how long they survive encounters with human judges of intelligence back to the mothership as a measure of fitness.
Annalisa expected she would never get to tell her story in open court and feared being sent to an offshore prison.
Judge Julius Pinsky is a United States District Court judge for the Southern District of New York.
Judge Pinsky is described as having surpassing intellectual curiosity and as a tenacious veteran of jurisdictional fights with DHS Special Prosecutors.
The defense attorney keeps Annalisa apprised of the judge's daily machinations on her behalf.
Lumpy is an AI that Annalisa bred in her studio apartment on the 16th floor of a student housing block in midtown Manhattan.
Judge Pinsky offers Annalisa a chance to give a live demo of Lumpy to a selection of DHS officials.
The DHS officials are described as sour-faced brush-cut creeps who expect Annalisa to emit a long hexadecimal key into the Judge's system.
